name: 作業一覧と承認詳細の分割画面
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0050 Japanese task-list / approval-detail split component. No outer app sidebar/header.
Original images1/2 PRIMARY for icon glyph anatomy, stroke/optical weight, proportions, grouping, visible states, controls, artwork, fine details. Image3 SECONDARY Japanese content/layout; restore its missing source controls/metadata and do not copy placeholder symbols/mint initial avatars. Preserve original portraits and colored-initial artwork, no synthesized replacement people. Complete readable 1200x854 logical layout, left44% list / right56% details, thin center divider, pure-white canvas.
LEFT top: original list-project square glyph (forest-green primary section marker) then「礼拝の準備」, down chevron, star, empty status circle「状態を設定」. Tabs「概要」「一覧」「ボード」「日程」「集計」「メモ」「作業量」「ファイル」, 一覧 selected green underline. White split plus「作業を追加」button, then column label「名称」.
Three expanded sections with original downward triangles, compact ruled rows:
「未着手」: parent circled-check「礼拝の資料を準備する」with source counters1/thumbs-up and2/dependency, yellow initials avatar. Nested SELECTED approval row with original approval/stamp glyph「資料の承認を依頼する」and original photo. Show selection via pale blue row+clear border, no mint. Next child circled-check「活動の目的を文書にする」;「子作業を追加…」. Diamond approval row「他の担当との日程を合わせる」with「2026年1月2日」and yellow initials. Circled-check「範囲と内容を決める打ち合わせ」with「火曜日」and photo;「作業を追加…」.
「進行中」: source first gray disabled/dependency row「[重複] 活動の目標を定義する」, counters1/thumb and2/comment, date「昨日 15:30」and muted photo. Second muted completed row filled greencheck「[重複] 活動の目標を定義する の複製」. Third circled-check「担当者と短く打ち合わせる」, date「今日」green, original photo.「作業を追加…」.
「完了」: circled-check「開始の打ち合わせを予定する」, red「12月19日」and yellow initials; filled greencheck muted「礼拝の台本を作成する」, gray「12月22日」and muted photo;「作業を追加…」. Bottom plus「区分を追加」. Retain source disabled/selected distinctions and metadata.
RIGHT: top action row forest-gradient「承認」with check; white「変更を依頼」with original amber circular-change glyph; white「却下」with red X. Right source toolbar icons thumbs-up, paperclip, dependency, chain-link, expand, ellipsis, close-pane arrow. No invented heart/club icons.
White notice with slate LOCK:「共同作業者と親の作業を閲覧できる人に表示されます。」right「公開する」. Breadcrumb「礼拝の準備」then「資料を準備する ›」. Heading「資料の確認」Meiryo Bold20/28.
Fields「担当者」original photo「山田 花子」X and「最近割り当て」chevron.「期日」original dashed circular calendar「期日なし」.「依存関係」「依存関係を追加」. Green link「継承した項目を表示」.
「項目」two-row fine outlined grid: original clock「予定工数」|「予定工数を追加」; original stopwatch「実績工数」|「実績を追加」and circled-play「計測を開始」. No values invented.
「説明」「内部で確認し、修正を反映する」. Below white plus「子作業を追加」.
Comments footer on WHITE: tabs「コメント」「すべての活動」active green underline; sort opposing-up/down icon「古い順」. Original photo beside empty outlined input「コメントを追加」. Bottom「共同作業者」original photo/colored initial/dashed-person/plus; right original filled bell「承認から退出」.
Official Meiryo Regular14/24, metadata12/16 tracking0; only established headings bold20/28. Slate #526173 utility glyphs; actual completion/status green and destructive red; white surfaces; fine neutral rules, restrained elevation, no nested cards/giant type/broad tinted panels/gloss. Restore source icon details, preserve all counts/date states and empty controls. Static candidate only.
reviewNotes: Full split layout inspected including selected/disabled rows, counters/dates, toolbar, empty fields, comments/footer. Gray notice/comments and dark-on-green project glyph remain; nested Add subtask translated as Add task. Portrait/source glyph/font fidelity unresolved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
